releases.summary: Phase 3 usability and safety release focused on one-time setup and automatic push protection.

features.title: One-time setup command
features.description: Added bgit setup to initialize configuration, install global pre-push safety checks, and prepare defaults

features.title: Automatic push safety checks
features.description: Added bgit check and managed pre-push hook integration to validate identity and remote alignment

features.title: Shell prompt integration
features.description: Added prompt-friendly identity output for shell integrations

features.title: Clone auto-bind by default
features.description: Repositories cloned with bgit clone are automatically bound to the effective identity by default

fixes.title: Consistent first-run behavior
fixes.description: Commands now trigger setup flow automatically when bgit has not been initialized

fixes.title: Uninstall cleanup
fixes.description: Uninstall now clears managed global hooks path and removes managed SSH config entries

breaking_changes.title: Legacy command deprecations
breaking_changes.description: bgit init and bgit setup-ssh are deprecated in favor of bgit setup; bgit remote fix is now legacy/advanced guidance

releases.summary: Code cleanup and improved installation experience.

features.title: Dynamic version fetching
features.description: Install scripts now automatically fetch the latest version from GitHub

fixes.title: Standardized user prompts
fixes.description: All confirmation prompts now use consistent UI patterns

fixes.title: Code cleanup
fixes.description: Removed unnecessary comments and improved code readability

releases.summary: Phase 2 release with workspace support and diagnostics.

features.title: Workspace management
features.description: Create organized workspace folders with automatic identity binding

features.title: Repository binding
features.description: Bind individual repositories to specific identities

features.title: Identity status
features.description: Show current identity status and bindings

features.title: Identity resolution
features.description: Automatic identity resolution based on workspace > binding > global priority

releases.summary: Initial release with core identity management features.

features.title: Multi-user identity management
features.description: Add, list, use, and delete Git identities

features.title: SSH key management
features.description: Generate or import SSH keys for each identity

features.title: Clone with identity
features.description: Clone repositories with the correct SSH configuration

features.title: Remote management
features.description: Fix and restore remote URLs for bgit compatibility

features.title: Safe uninstall
features.description: Safely uninstall bgit and restore all repositories

features.title: Cross-platform support
features.description: Works on Linux, macOS, and Windows
